name: Rising Sun

categories.label: VP track after Autumn (before winter bonuses)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track VP (trước thưởng cuối game)
categories.hint: Position of your marker on the VP track; add 50 if the marker has looped past 50.

categories.label: Winter upgrade VP
categories.labelVi: Điểm từ thẻ nâng cấp Winter
categories.hint: Total VP granted by your Winter Season cards, per their own criteria.

categories.label: War Province tokens by Season won
categories.labelVi: Thẻ tỉnh chiến tranh theo mùa thắng
categories.hint: Spring token = 1 VP, Summer = 2 VP, Autumn = 3 VP.

categories.label: Different War Provinces collected
categories.labelVi: Số tỉnh chiến tranh khác nhau
categories.hint: Count distinct Provinces only: 3-4 = 10 VP, 5-6 = 20 VP, 7-8 = 30 VP.

categories.label: Honor track position (tiebreak, 1 = highest)
categories.labelVi: Thứ hạng Honor (phân định hòa, 1 = cao nhất)
categories.hint: Slot on the Honor track from the top; lower number wins ties.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the highest Honor (top-most on the Honor track) wins
If two Allied players tie for first, they share the victory.

notes: family: auction-money. Game ends at the start of Winter; scoring is VP track (gained during play) plus final bonuses. Enter VP track as it stands after Autumn, then winter cards and tokens are added here. Source is a close paraphrase of the CMON rulebook on UltraBoardGames; official PDF could not be retrieved (CMON site blocked), so confidence is medium. Alliance shared-victory only when allied players tie for first.
